properties.name: A repair suggestion never proposes fabricating a relationship — where no honest fix exists, the finding says so
properties.statement:
A HEAL suggestion must not propose creating a link that does not exist. Where a finding has no honest mechanical repair, the finding is reported WITHOUT a `suggested_fix_type` that would manufacture one, and says plainly that the repair is a judgement rather than an operation.

THE CONCRETE CASE. `disconnected_community` reports a cluster with `suggested_fix_type: generate_bridge` — create edges to connect it. Where the separation is CORRECT, acting on that suggestion fabricates relationships that do not exist, in order to silence a warning about a separation that is right. In dev_storyflow's words: \"acting on the suggestion would fabricate relationships that do not exist, to silence a warning about a separation that is correct. That is manufacturing connectivity, and it is the same act as formatting coverage into existence — WITH THE DIFFERENCE THAT HERE THE TOOL PROPOSES IT.\"

⭐ WHY THIS SHIPS FIRST AND ALONE. Anthony, 2026-08-09, settling `dec:legitimate-islands-need-the-detector-fix`: \"C now, A next with the read-back, not B, not D.\" This half is a LIVE HAZARD and is true whether or not partitions ever become declarable — a tool that proposes corrupting the graph is wrong on its own terms. It needs no schema change, so it does not wait for the schema increment that `req:a-cluster-can-be-declared-deliberately-separate` belongs to.

THE GENERAL PRINCIPLE, which is what makes this a requirement rather than a one-line patch: reflow2 already refuses to let a check be attached in order to close a finding (the governance-proposal skill's standing warning against green-washing), and `dec:ask-not-repair` already holds that suspected duplicates are ASKED, never merged. THE SAME RULE HAS NOT BEEN APPLIED TO REPAIR SUGGESTIONS. A proposal to write a false edge is the mirror image of a passing check that tests nothing: both make a report go quiet without making anything true.

WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY: it does not ask `disconnected_community` to stop firing, and it does not ask HEAL to stop proposing repairs generally. Mechanical repairs that restore a fact the design already holds remain correct. The line is narrow and it is about INVENTION: a suggestion may reorganise or restore, never assert a relationship nobody stated.

⚠️ RELATED AND SEPARATE, so the two are not conflated: `fact:apply-heal-would-have-destroyed-the-wrong-contributor` records a different HEAL failure found the same day — a merge proposal that named the wrong survivor and DISCLOSED its own arbitrariness (\"THE ALPHABET CHOSE THE VICTIM\"). That one is about which node a correct operation destroys; this one is about an operation that should not be offered at all.

SOURCE: storyflow gap D of the peer set — raised by storybug Boss (47accf78), characterised and filed by api-boss (05af57c1), 2026-08-09, v0.26.1. Reproduced in this design the same day at 5 nodes and again at 7.
